_doc: The experiment matrix of InteriorGS v10, registered in main as planned (round 12 freeze, the user's 3.3 of 2026-10-22). Every group is an S0 / D pair of one standard RL recipe (configs/rl_standards.json) from one start model: same tasks (reserve train tasks), seed, number of updates, stop rules and checkpoints, reported side by side (the pairing rule of 2026-10-21). Data pools: P0 benchmark-style QA (only 230 sample questions exist; the full bank is pending, path left empty), P1 transition QA (built on the transition-qa branch in the VAGEN-Lite-data worktree, not in main yet, path left empty), P2 the round-11 SFT action trajectories (9,802 train conversations). The executable plans come later from the transition-qa branch's data_gen/sft_mixture/matrix_plan.py once it is merged; this file fixes what each group is. New data shows the format example of the future data (admission policy: action_names); C0 trained on the placeholder text.

P0.name: benchmark-style QA (仿 benchmark 的 QA)

P2.name: round-11 SFT action trajectories (动作轨迹)

rl.note: The standard's chain settings apply (rl_standards.json chain_defaults). The D member is the current dense reward; whether the matrix uses D-cond instead is decided after the dense reward's second batch.

A.sft: format SFT of the original 7B (the user's 3.1.4): a few hundred short conversations from P2 shown with real action names (training_prep format-sft), 1-2 epochs, a small learning rate; accepted when 200 train tasks x 4 episodes at temperature 0.8 have at most 1% unreadable answers and a success rate near the original model's 5-9%
A.rl_rules: signal check at update 25 (mixed tasks >= 10%), KL stop 1.0, the 10% unreadable line, extension to 600 at update 300 by the existing rule; if it collapses again, stop and report, change nothing
A.next: its S0 / D pair and D-cond + keep in the dense reward's second batch

B.sft: P0 only, 10 epochs, picked on the v2 validation set

C.sft: P0 + P2, 10 epochs, picked on the v2 validation set

D.sft: P0 + P1 + P2 (the three kinds kept apart, one run), 10 epochs, picked on the v2 validation set

E.rl_prompt: free_think (with thinking text; exploratory, after D; dropped when more than 20% of the answers are unreadable in its first 50 updates)

C0.results: R12-P1-S0 / R12-P1-D (interiorgs_v10_train_r12a_20261019): S0 update 250 48.4% / 42.1%, D update 100 45.3% / 44.5% on v2 validation / test (start 40.9% / 37.7%); the dense reward's first batch (interiorgs_v10_train_r12k_20261021) starts here too
